en: Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a uniformed guard in front of a striped sentry box. The soldier wears a spiked helmet (Pickelhaube), long tunic with decorative braiding, white trousers, and tall boots, and carries a rifle on his back and a sword at his side. He stands in a proud pose before the guardhouse. In the upper right corner there is a smaller inset image of a young woman in traditional folk-style dress reaching out with a flower or small object, as if addressing the guard. A small red number is handwritten near the lower right edge.
